word.definition: Outlandish can describe things that are strikingly strange or unusual; in this use, it’s a synonym of bizarre .

sports_fact.text: The longest tennis match ever lasted 11 hours and 5 minutes over three days: Isner beat Mahut 70-68 in the fifth set at Wimbledon 2010. The scoreboard wasn't programmed to go that high.

quote.text: Few can believe that suffering, especially by others, is in vain. Anything that is disagreeable must surely have beneficial economic effects.
